v4.26 overworld models — review sheet

Hand-drawn vector cel models (tools/v426), 192×256 frames. “1x” = the size on the map (86 css px tall); “zoomed” = the sheet’s own frames (~3x). Diagonals use the side rows. The loops at the end of each block play the frames at the in-game cadence for a steady walk.
